items.title: Doncic: I Told Lakers I Wanted Them To Acquire Kessler
items.summary: When the Lakers surrendered two unprotected first-round picks and two pick swaps in order to sign Walker Kessler to a four-year, $130MM contract over the summer, reporting at the time identified him as Luka Doncic’s preferred target and suggested the Lakers’ front office was willing to pay the steep price to pry him out of Utah because it was what their franchise player wanted. Speaking to ESPN’s Dave McMenamin, Doncic confirmed as much. “I told them after the season I wanted Walker,” Doncic said. “I think he’s a really good player. Obviously, last season he didn’t play (due to shoulder surgery). He played like five games. Obviously (Utah) kept him out, but just playing against him in the previous years, it was hard to score. items.title: Grizzlies Sign Lawson Lovering To 10-Day Hardship Deal
items.summary: The Grizzlies have been granted a hardship exception and have used it to sign center Lawson Lovering to a 10-day contract, reports Shams Charania of ESPN (Twitter link). The signing is official, the team confirmed in a press release (Twitter link). A hardship exception allows a team hit hard by injuries to temporarily exceed the standard 15-man limit. A club qualifies if it has at least four players who have missed three or more games, assuming each of those four players is expected to be out for at least two more weeks. Memphis forwards Jerami Grant (calf) and Cameron Boozer (ankle) have been sidelined for the past three games and aren’t expected to return anytime soon. They join GG Jackson II (foot surgery) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (lumbar disc herniation) among the Grizzlies dealing with longer-term injuries. items.title: Canada Qualifies For 2027 FIBA World Cup
items.summary: The Canadian men’s national team lost its first qualifying game for the 2027 FIBA World Cup on Thursday, falling to Uruguay, 84-78, per Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca (Twitter links). Veteran big man Kelly Olynyk, who has been playing in Italy this season after 13 years in the NBA, had 21 points (on 7-of-11 shooting), six rebounds, three blocks, two steals and two assists in defeat. However, Canada still qualified for next summer’s tournament later in the evening when the Bahamas was blown out by Argentina, Murphy adds. Canada, which is now 8-1 in Group F, is the first country from the Americas to qualify for the 2027 World Cup.
